chapter: Blue Devils, Moten and the Reno Club
title: The 'mad scuffle' and not being in and out of the Reno Club
summary: Basie says every new band scuffles, but disputes that they were in and out of the Reno Club for a year; when they left, they were on their way to New York.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
